JPD-12.description: Six days across Hokkaido: Noboribetsu's Edo-era village and volcanic valley, a Lake Toya hot-spring night, Otaru's canal and glass studios, then Sapporo's markets, shrine and Mt. Moiwa night view.
JPD-12.long_description: Start in Chitose and travel into the volcanic heart of Hokkaido. At Noboribetsu, step back into the Edo period at Date Jidaimura, walk the steaming Jigokudani valley and look out over Mt. Showa-Shinzan, then meet penguins and marine life at Noboribetsu Marine Park Nixe. Spend a night at a Lake Toya hot-spring hotel before following the coast to Otaru, where stone warehouses line the canal and Sakaimachi Street is known for its music boxes and Kitaichi glass. Three nights in Sapporo open up Hokkaido Shrine, Nijo Market, Odori Park, the Former Hokkaido Government Office, Shiroi Koibito Park and the cable car up Mt. Moiwa for one of Japan's celebrated night views.

CUS-6.description: Eight days across Shaanxi and Henan: the Terracotta Army, Mt. Hua's cable-car trails, Longmen Grottoes, Shaolin Temple and the Tang-dynasty lights of Xi'an.
CUS-6.long_description: Travel from Xi'an to Mt. Hua, Luoyang, Dengfeng, Sanmenxia and Lintong on a route that brings China's early imperial history together. See the three pits of Emperor Qinshihuang's Terracotta Army, ride the shuttle and cable car up Mt. Hua, and explore the Longmen Grottoes' thousands of Buddhist carvings. At Dengfeng, visit the Shaolin Temple — the home of Zen and kung fu — including the Pagoda Forest and a martial-arts performance. The journey continues to the cave dwellings of Shanzhou, the night lights of Datang Everbright City, the Bell and Drum Square, Muslim Street and Yongxingfang Food Street.

10XBI.description: Ten days from Istanbul to Cappadocia, Konya, Pamukkale, Ephesus and the North Aegean, with cave-hotel nights and a Bosphorus cruise.
10XBI.long_description: Cross Türkiye from Istanbul to the Anatolian heartland and back to the Aegean. In Ankara, visit Atatürk's mausoleum; in Cappadocia, descend into an underground city and take in Uchisar Castle, Pigeon Valley, the Three Beauties and Göreme's fairy chimneys from the viewpoints. Stay two nights in a cave-design or stone-house hotel, enjoy a belly-dance show in a Cappadocia cave and visit the Mevlana Museum in Konya. Continue to Pamukkale's white travertine terraces and the ancient spa city of Hierapolis, then the House of the Virgin Mary and the marble streets of Ephesus. The route ends with the Trojan Horse at Çanakkale, the Grand Bazaar, the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapı Palace and a Bosphorus cruise in Istanbul.

PECZ-3.description: Ten days by rail, boat and cable car through Zurich, Mt. Rigi, Lucerne, Interlaken, Bern, the Lavaux vineyards and Zermatt's Gornergrat.
PECZ-3.long_description: Switzerland unfolds by train, lake boat and mountain railway on this ten-day route. Start in Zurich with the Fraumünster, Lindenhof, the Swiss National Museum and Bahnhofstrasse, then ride the cogwheel railway up Mt. Rigi for 360-degree views and cruise Lake Lucerne past the Chapel Bridge and Lion Monument. Continue to Interlaken and Lake Thun, walk Bern's old town with its clock tower and bear park, and taste wine in the Lavaux vineyards above Lake Geneva. Visit Chillon Castle, see the Aletsch Glacier, then travel to Zermatt for the Gornergrat railway — Europe's highest cogwheel line — and the Glacier Express through the Alps.

AMA-DANUBE-LNY-2027.description: Seven nights along the Danube from Budapest to Bratislava, Melk, Linz and Vienna, with a Lunar New Year gala dinner and Mandarin-language service.
AMA-DANUBE-LNY-2027.long_description: Celebrate Lunar New Year on a seven-night Danube cruise aboard a 156-guest AmaWaterways river ship. Embark in Budapest, then sail to Bratislava for a walking tour, a 'Tastes of Slovakia' tasting, a castle hike or a bike ride; continue through the Strudengau to Melk Abbey and Linz, with options for Salzburg, Cesky Krumlov or the city's UNESCO media-arts mile. Two days in Vienna bring an imperial carriage tour or bike ride, Schönbrunn Palace and the Vienna Woods, plus free time and the festive Lunar New Year Gala Dinner. The cruise ends with a day in Budapest for the Buda castle district, a Castle Hill hike or a Pest tour. Daily programmes, menus and shore experiences are offered in English and Mandarin, with Mandarin-speaking crew on board.

OCE-SIRENA-MAR2027.description: Nine days aboard Oceania Sirena from Lisbon to Rome, with calls at Portimão, Seville, Málaga, Barcelona, Cannes and Cinque Terre.
OCE-SIRENA-MAR2027.long_description: Sail from Lisbon to Rome on a nine-day Mediterranean run aboard the 684-guest Oceania Sirena. The itinerary follows Portugal's Atlantic coast to Portimão, turns into Seville (Cádiz) and Málaga, then crosses to Barcelona before reaching Cannes and the Italian Riviera at Cinque Terre (La Spezia). A day at sea breaks up the port days, and the cruise finishes in Rome (Civitavecchia). Fares include free Wi-Fi for two, gratuities for two and a choice of complimentary wine and beer with lunch and dinner or a USD 400 shore-excursion credit for two, plus non-alcoholic beverages and specialty-restaurant fees.

SILV-ENDEAVOUR-JUL2027.description: Eleven days from Copenhagen to Longyearbyen and Tromsø, exploring Svalbard's fjords and Bear Island aboard the all-suite Silver Endeavour.
SILV-ENDEAVOUR-JUL2027.long_description: Join Silver Endeavour for an 11-day Arctic expedition from Copenhagen to Tromsø. Fly to Longyearbyen and embark for six days exploring Svalbard's northern region, where the captain and expedition team choose landing sites according to ice and weather. The ship calls at Bear Island, then follows the North Cape to Skarsvåg before finishing in Tromsø. With only 220 guests, every suite comes with butler service, and the fare includes all drinks, five restaurants, daily shore excursions, expedition gear, Wi-Fi, gratuities and the two in-country flights.

SILV-SPIRIT-MAY2027.description: Sixteen days round-trip from Copenhagen to Norway's North Cape and Trondheim aboard Silver Spirit, with all-suite butler service and all drinks included.
SILV-SPIRIT-MAY2027.long_description: Sail round-trip from Copenhagen on a 16-day Norwegian fjords voyage aboard Silver Spirit. The route follows the coast to Olden, Leknes in the Lofoten Islands, Honningsvåg at the North Cape, Alta and Trondheim, with scenic cruising along the North Cape and calls at Molde, Vik and Skagen. Sea days give time to enjoy the all-suite ship, its nine restaurants and butler service. Fares include all drinks, Wi-Fi, on-board gratuities and taxes and fees; shore excursions are not included on this U3 fare.
